subject: APPLIED lowering-air-opus: AIR-only wiring in shared tree (claimed regions); building Rust bridge + host Mali (AIR) next
body: render_pipeline.inc, pipeline_cache_frontend.inc, render_encoder.inc (TEGU_PERF_AIR), air_bridge.rs/.h (tegu_air_library_air_source), tools/build_native_compilers.py + build_callable_compilers.py (-DTEGU_MALI_AIR, air/ sources). Default TEGU_AIR_DIRECT=1 = AIR-only codegen for generic render pipelines (refusal -> TEGU_AIR_REFUSED, no m2v code). m2v translation still runs for planner metadata only. HEAVY TAKE: cargo release build of tegu_air_bridge (workers/compute target) then mesa-build libnord2_mali_runtime with AIR.
